The respondent No.1 - Special Land Acquisition Officer, Metro Rail Project has sent this reference under Section 30 and 31 of L.A. Act, for apportionment of compensation amount.

sentences.text: .2. The brief facts of the case is that the land bearing Sy.No.61/4 measuring 18 sq. meters of Vajarahalli, Hemmigepura ward No. 198 within the limits of BBMP has been acquired for the purpose of Metro Rail Project.
Preliminary notification was issued on 24.12.2014.
Final notification has been published on 19/22.12.2015.
The award was passed on 11.05.2016.
The L.A.O. has fixed the compensation of Rs. 7,62,944/-.

As there was a dispute with regard to the title, the L.A.O. has sent the reference to the Court after deducting Income tax and deposited a sum of Rs.
6,10,355/-.
The said amount has been kept in F.D. in SBI, Cauvery Bhavan Branch, Bengaluru.
After receipt of the reference, this Court issued notice to both parties.

Both parties have appeared through their counsel.
 .4.

The claimant has filed claim statement stating that he is the absolute owner of the land bearing Sy.No.
61/4 measuring 1 acre 5 guntas situated at Vajarahalli village, Uttarahalli Hobli, Bengaluru South Taluka.

The claimant has sold Sy.No. 61/4 measuring 1 acre Vajrappa vs Unknown on 11 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24799637/
2 situated at Vajarahalli village in-favour of Subramanya A.M. and thereafter the Government has forfeited the land in LRF CR 5/1997-98 on 23.05.2019 as the said sale is in violation of the terms and conditions of Section 79(A) and (B) of KLR Act.
It is stated that thereafter vide MR No. H14/2011-12 the RTC Extract was restored in the name of claimant and hence, the claimant is the absolute owner of the said property.

It is stated that H. Muniraju has filed revision petition before the Deputy Commissioner in RP No.413/2011-12 against A.N. Rajgopal and A.N. Shanara Narayana Settee in-respect of the land bearing Sy.No. 61  4  L.A.C. No. 106/2016 measuring 1 acre 30 guntas and Sy.No. 61/1 measuring 29 guntas of Vajarahalli village and the same is remanded to the Assistant Commissioner for afresh disposal.
Hence, prayed for allowing his claim.
.5. The respondent No. 2 has filed objections stating that an extent of 18 sq. meters of Sy.No. 61/4 of Vajarahalli village, BBMP ward No. 198 came to be acquired for Bengaluru Metro Rail Project.
It is stated that after receiving the compensation package from defendant No. 2, the SLAO issued notice under Section 29(2) of KIAD Act to the khatedars.

Though the notice under Section 29(2) was issued, the khathedar /
interested persons remained absent.

sentences.text: In view of the said deposit, the respondent No. 2 - BMRCL who is beneficiary of acquisition will not be liable to pay interest on the awarded compensation amount.
.6. In order to prove his case, the claimant is examined as PW.1.

The documents got marked at Ex.P.1 to 7.
 .7.

Heard the arguments on main.
 .8.

The following points that would arise for my consideration are:
 1) Whether the Claimant is  entitled for compensation?

My findings on the above points are:
 Point No.1 : In the negative  Point No.2 : As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS  .10.
POINT No.1: The claimant has been examined as PW.1.
He has stated that he is the absolute owner of the land bearing Sy.No.61/4 measuring 1 acre 5 guntas situated at Vajarahalli village.
He has acquired the same from Lakshmamma W/o Maregowda under the registered sale deed dated 13.01.1937.

To substantiate the same, he has not  6 Vajrappa vs Unknown on 11 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24799637/

PW.1 has stated that the Government has mentioned his name in the RTC Extract in-respect of non-alienated portion of 5 guntas.

From the document, it is seen that name of claimant is not mentioned.
Ex.P.2 is the record of rights.

From the said document, at Sl.

Ex.P.4 is the mutation in MR No. 9/98- 99.
From the said document, it is seen that in pursuance to the order of Deputy Commissioner, LRF CR 5/92-93 in-respect of Sy.No. 61/4 to an extent of 1 acre has been forfeited to the Government.

PW. 1 has stated that H. Muniraju has filed Revision petition before the Deputy Commissioner in R.P. No. 413/2011-12 against A.N. Rajgopal and A.N.
Shanara Narayana Settee in-respect of Sy.No. 61 measuring 1 acre 30 guntas and Sy.No. 61/1 measuring 29 guntas of Vajarahalli village and the same is remanded to the Assistant Commissioner for afresh disposal.

PW. 1 has stated that during pendency of R.P.
No. 413/2011-12 dated 23.01.2012 the Commissioner has stayed the proceedings in-respect of the aforesaid properties and the same was disposed on 01.06.2016.
PW.1 has stated that the land acquired by the respondent is not the subject matter of the aforesaid litigations.

PW.1 has stated that vide MR No.
H14/2011-12 the RTC Extract was restored in his name  8  L.A.C. No. 106/2016 and hence, he is the absolute owner of the said property.
Ex.P.5 is the order of the Deputy Commissioner in Revision petition No. 413/2011-12 in- respect of Sy.No. 61 measuring 1.30, 61/1 - 29 guntas.

From the order, it is seen that:

From the above order, it is seen that the lands in Vajarahalli village are Jodigrama.

In view of the Mysore (Personal and Miscellaneous) Inams Abolition Act, 1954,
the lands are vested with the Government.

entities.text: Mysore (Personal and Miscellaneous) Inams Abolition Act, 1954
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The claimant has not produced any documents to show that the application was filed for grant of occupancy rights.
9  L.A.C. No. 106/2016 There is no order of the Spl. Deputy Commissioner granting occupancy rights in-favour of claimant.
It is settled law that the revenue records are not the documents of title and only on the basis of revenue records, it cannot be held that the claimant has title to the property.

As claimant has failed to prove title subsequent to the Mysore (Personal and Miscellaneous)
Inam Abolition Act
, I am of the view that the claimant is not entitled for compensation.
Hence, point No.1 for consideration is answered in the negative.
.13. POINT NO.2:

In view of my finding on point No.1, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
The reference made by the and 31 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 is hereby dismissed.
